notes:
- Other signed-in BondoMod players can now see your equipped spawned items, including when joining a match. Enable Item Spawn and start Rocket League with Launch RL on both PCs.
- Item Spawn now requires a BondoMod account. Creating an account and spawning normal items are free.
- Fixed Name Changer blocking Launch RL when Item Spawn and Titles are turned off.
- Added correct primary and accent paint-finish slots, including retention across match loadout updates.
- Improved Customs compatibility after game updates by keeping texture backups separate for each package version.
- Reordered Base Plugins: Items, Customs, Workshop Maps, Platform Display, Rank Display and MMR Display. Rank Display is under development.
